{{Infobox auto}}

'''Japanese curry''' is one of the oven meals. It heals {{Value|Japanese Curry|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Strength}} for {{Value|Japanese Curry|duration|effect=Strength}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/japanese_curry.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[curry stock]] cooks into Japanese curry in {{Value|Japanese Curry|cook_time}} in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Japanese Curry|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Japanese Curry|heals}} and gives Strength {{Value|Japanese Curry|level|effect=Strength}} for {{Value|Japanese Curry|duration|effect=Strength|format=clock}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_38.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''Hearty Curry'': make Japanese curry (1 [[obol]]).
